scope: English for Vietnamese Pre-A1/A0-B1 knowledge research
notice: Research registry only. Re-check exact release, checksum, upstream lineage and rights before ingestion. This is not legal advice.

decisionPolicy.PRIMARY_CANDIDATE: May be used to design the first production pipeline after pinned-release QA and required attribution.
decisionPolicy.REFERENCE_ONLY: May inform human decisions; protected data is not copied into production.
decisionPolicy.CANDIDATE_QUARANTINE: Potentially useful but blocked on share-alike, provenance, redistribution, quality or schema review.
decisionPolicy.REJECT_MVP: Excluded from the first production knowledge pack.

sources.name: Council of Europe CEFR / Companion Volume
sources.productionUse: Framework and can-do terminology only; never present CEFR as an official word-level certifier.

sources.name: CEFR-J Wordlist Version 1.6
sources.rights: Copyright Tono Laboratory, Tokyo University of Foreign Studies; documented for research and commercial use with proper acknowledgement.
sources.productionUse: Primary A1-B1 lemma/POS level prior; pin authoritative artifact, version and checksum.

sources.name: CEFR-J Grammar Profile
sources.rights: CEFR-J/Open Language Profiles documents research/commercial use with citation; mirror release must be distinguished from current official release.
sources.productionUse: Normalize selected A1-B1 grammar units manually and preserve upstream IDs/version.

sources.name: TUFS CEFR-J x 28
sources.rights: Public project/sample resources found; production redistribution rights for the Vietnamese phrase/vocabulary assets were not established in this review.
sources.productionUse: Use methodology and structure as research reference; do not copy Vietnamese phrase/vocabulary data without explicit rights confirmation.

sources.name: Open English WordNet 2025
sources.rights: CC BY 4.0
sources.productionUse: Filter to selected curriculum; human-review learner-facing meanings/relations; retain attribution and source IDs.

sources.name: PanLex
sources.rights: PanLex Database snapshots, Lite and Swadesh lists released under CC0 1.0.
sources.productionUse: English-Vietnamese equivalence candidates only; human sense review required before learner-facing Vietnamese text.

sources.name: New General Service List 1.2 and related NGSL lists
sources.rights: Official project permits commercial use; several lists are CC BY-SA 4.0, creating attribution/share-alike obligations for adaptations.
sources.productionUse: Research/ranking signal first. Do not copy list/rank data into the core catalog until share-alike handling is explicitly approved.

sources.name: KELLY English frequency/CEFR list
sources.rights: English/Leeds distribution is CC BY-NC-SA 2.0.
sources.productionUse: Independent research cross-check only; no commercial production import.

sources.name: English Vocabulary Profile / English Grammar Profile
sources.rights: Search/reference access is useful; no bulk redistribution licence established for this project.
sources.productionUse: Human validation of ambiguous decisions; no scraping or bulk copy.

sources.name: EFLLex
sources.rights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
sources.productionUse: Research comparison only.

sources.name: Vietnamese/Open Multilingual WordNet candidates
sources.rights: Per-resource licences and upstream provenance vary; public Vietnamese mirrors may inherit Wiktionary or other rights.
sources.productionUse: Research only until exact Vietnamese resource and lineage are verified; PanLex remains the cleaner V1 bilingual candidate.

sources.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
sources.rights: Broad use/copy/modify/distribute permission subject to notices/acknowledgement.
sources.productionUse: Wait for an approved first-class pronunciation schema/API.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice
sources.rights: CC0 dataset with current Mozilla Data Collective terms including no identity attempts and distribution/re-host constraints.
sources.productionUse: Research/model evaluation only until learner-facing audio redistribution is explicitly cleared.

sources.name: Wiktionary via Wiktextract / Kaikki
sources.rights: Parser code licence does not replace Wiktionary content licences; content is governed by Wiktionary share-alike/GFDL terms.
sources.productionUse: Later enrichment only after share-alike/provenance design.

sources.name: Tatoeba
sources.rights: Default sentence redistribution CC BY 2.0; some eligible originals CC0; translation and audio rights require item-level handling.
sources.productionUse: Per-record candidate examples later; first production pack uses original LINGUA-authored sentences.

sources.name: UniMorph English
sources.rights: Share-alike licensed dataset.
sources.productionUse: Later form validation; first pack prefers deterministic/manual forms.

sources.name: Leipzig Corpora Collection
sources.rights: Query data and downloadable-corpus terms differ; source documents originate from varied web material.
sources.productionUse: Possible aggregate research after source-specific review; not first learner-facing sentence source.

sources.name: UniversalCEFR / mixed CEFR corpora
sources.rights: Collection aggregates datasets with heterogeneous licences; many are non-commercial and/or source-restricted.
sources.productionUse: Research/evaluation only; never trust a wrapper licence to override upstream rights.

sources.name: ICNALE
sources.rights: Terms prohibit reproduction/redistribution of part or all of the data.
sources.productionUse: Use aggregate published research findings only; never ship learner texts.

sources.name: EF-Cambridge Open Language Database
sources.rights: Academic/private-study/non-commercial agreement with derivative restrictions.
sources.productionUse: Research literature only.

sources.name: Universal Dependencies English-EWT
sources.rights: Share-alike annotations; underlying texts have mixed provenance.
sources.productionUse: Use to inform/evaluate deterministic complexity features; do not republish source sentences.

sources.name: LanguageTool
sources.rights: Core LGPL 2.1 or later.
sources.productionUse: Optional authoring QA only, never curriculum authority or core runtime dependency.

sources.name: wordfreq
sources.rights: Code and bundled data have different licences; data aggregates many upstream sources and includes share-alike obligations; data snapshot is effectively sunset around 2021.
sources.productionUse: Do not export/copy its frequency data into V1 catalog.

sources.name: ConceptNet
sources.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 data.
sources.productionUse: Do not use as authoritative prerequisite graph.

sources.name: SyntagNet
sources.rights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
sources.productionUse: No commercial production import.

sources.name: WithEnglishWeCan/generated-english-phrasal-verbs
sources.rights: Repository states MIT, but generated output lacks a sufficiently explicit upstream source/provenance chain in the root repository review.
sources.productionUse: Do not ingest until generation sources and data rights are independently verified.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg
sources.rights: Public-domain status varies by title and jurisdiction; text style is often a poor fit for modern Pre-A1-B1 micro-content.
sources.productionUse: Not needed for the first modern learner-content pack.

globalGuardrails: Repository/software licence does not automatically license embedded or generated language data.
Aggregator/wrapper licence never overrides upstream content rights.
Share-alike sources require an explicit segregation/attribution/redistribution decision before production import.
Research papers inform pedagogy; their stimuli/examples are not copied unless separately licensed.
Knowledge relations never transfer Save/Learn intent, FSRS state, competence or mastery between concepts.
